Exact radical alias proves 3-channel insufficiency within a common finite horizon. Strict negativity of the second logarithmic derivative proves unique gap optimum. Standard-library standalone checker passes 1312 counted checks; finite experiments are only supplementary.

value.rationale: Environmental passive samplers integrate concentration over time, obscuring event counts; a sharp minimal number of simultaneous calibrated kinetic channels that distinguishes one pulse from two equal, separated pulses is a natural inverse-monitoring question. The exact three-channel alias establishes genuine information loss, and the strict gap-contrast optimum identifies blind regimes at near-merging and remote separation. The constrained, noise-free setting and feasibility hurdles limit practical claims but not the nontrivial structural result.
